Assign and check pseudotime windows.
```{r}
assign_pseudotime_windows <- function(
  seurat_obj,
  pseudotime_col,
  mode = c("sliding", "stratified"),
  window_size = NULL,          # used in sliding mode
  windows_per_anno = NULL,     # used in stratified mode
  cell_anno_col = NULL,        # used in stratified mode
  output_col = "pseudotime_windows"
) {
  # Validate mode
  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  meta[[output_col]] <- NA_character_

  if (mode == "sliding") {
    # ----- Argument check -----
    if (is.null(window_size)) stop("`window_size` must be provided when mode = 'sliding'")

    # Extract pseudotime
    pt_values <- meta[[pseudotime_col]]
    cells <- rownames(meta)

    df <- data.frame(
      cell = cells,
      pseudotime = pt_values,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # Order cells by pseudotime
    df_ordered <- df[order(df$pseudotime, na.last = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]

    # Non-NA pseudotime
    non_na_idx <- which(!is.na(df_ordered$pseudotime))
    n_non_na <- length(non_na_idx)

    if (n_non_na == 0) {
      seurat_obj@meta.data[[output_col]] <- NA
      return(seurat_obj)
    }

    # Assign windows
    window_ids <- ceiling(seq_len(n_non_na) / window_size)

    # Merge last window if too small
    last_window_size <- n_non_na - (max(window_ids) - 1) * window_size
    if (last_window_size < window_size && max(window_ids) > 1) {
      window_ids[window_ids == max(window_ids)] <- max(window_ids) - 1
    }

    # Assign labels
    labels <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(df_ordered))
    labels[non_na_idx] <- paste0("pt_window_", window_ids)
    labels_by_cell <- setNames(labels, df_ordered$cell)
    meta[[output_col]] <- labels_by_cell[rownames(meta)]

  } else if (mode == "stratified") {
    # ----- Argument check -----
    if (is.null(windows_per_anno) || is.null(cell_anno_col)) {
      stop("`windows_per_anno` and `cell_anno_col` must be provided when mode = 'stratified'")
    }

    current_window_id <- 1  # global counter

    # Loop over each annotation
    for (anno in names(windows_per_anno)) {
      n_windows <- windows_per_anno[[anno]]

      # Cells in this annotation with valid pseudotime
      idx <- which(
        meta[[cell_anno_col]] == anno &
        !is.na(meta[[pseudotime_col]])
      )

      if (length(idx) == 0) {
        current_window_id <- current_window_id + n_windows
        next
      }

      # Order cells by pseudotime
      idx_ordered <- idx[order(meta[[pseudotime_col]][idx])]

      # Local window IDs
      local_ids <- cut(
        seq_along(idx_ordered),
        breaks = n_windows,
        labels = FALSE
      )

      # Map to global IDs
      global_ids <- local_ids + current_window_id - 1
      meta[[output_col]][idx_ordered] <- paste0("pt_window_", global_ids)

      # Advance global counter
      current_window_id <- current_window_id + n_windows
    }
  }

  seurat_obj@meta.data <- meta
  return(seurat_obj)
}

```


```{r}
se <- assign_pseudotime_windows(
  se,
  pseudotime_col = "cell_rank_ordered",
  mode = "stratified",
  cell_anno_col = "cell_anno",
  windows_per_anno = list(NSC = 2, INP = 3, NB  = 3, YGN = 2, GN  = 3)
)

table(se$pseudotime_windows)
```


Plot pseudotime window assignment.
```{r}
#library(dplyr)
#library(ggplot2)

# Extract metadata
meta <- se[[]]

# Set colors
cell_colors <- c(
  "NSC" = "#FC8D62",
  "INP" = "#E78AC3",
  "NB"  = "#8DA0CB",
  "YGN" = "#A6D854",
  "GN"  = "#66C2A5"
)

# Ensure cell_rank_ordered is a factor (discrete)
meta$cell_rank_ordered <- factor(
  meta$cell_rank_ordered,
  levels = sort(unique(meta$cell_rank_ordered)),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Ensure pseudotime windows are ordered numerically
meta$pseudotime_windows <- factor(
  meta$pseudotime_windows,
  levels = paste0(
    "pt_window_",
    seq_len(max(
      as.numeric(gsub("pt_window_", "", meta$pseudotime_windows)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ))
  ),
  ordered = TRUE
)

# Count cells per type per rank and compute fractions
plot_long <- meta %>%
  filter(cell_anno %in% names(cell_colors)) %>%
  count(cell_rank_ordered, cell_anno, name = "Count") %>%
  group_by(cell_rank_ordered) %>%
  mutate(Fraction = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(CellType = cell_anno)

plot_long$CellType <- factor(plot_long$CellType, levels = names(cell_colors))

# Compute window boundaries
window_bounds <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(pseudotime_windows)) %>%
  group_by(pseudotime_windows) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(as.numeric(cell_rank_ordered)),
    end   = max(as.numeric(cell_rank_ordered)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(start)

# Vertical line positions (between windows)
vline_positions <- window_bounds$end[-nrow(window_bounds)] + 0.5

# Window label positions
window_labels <- window_bounds %>%
  mutate(xpos = (start + end) / 2)

# X-axis breaks and labels = start of each window
x_breaks <- window_bounds$start
x_labels <- window_bounds$start  # numeric ticks

# Plot
ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = cell_rank_ordered, y = Fraction, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = vline_positions,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = window_labels,
    aes(x = xpos, y = 1.05, label = pseudotime_windows),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Cell rank",
    y = "Fraction of cells",
    title = "Cell type composition along trajectory with pseudotime windows"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.5))) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = levels(meta$cell_rank_ordered)[x_breaks],
    labels = x_labels
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

```


# Gene set scores

```{r}
find_OT_genes_per_window <- function(DEG_genes, OT_genes) {
  
  # extract numeric window index
  window_df <- data.frame(
    cluster = unique(DEG_genes$cluster),
    window_num = as.integer(sub("pt_window_", "", unique(DEG_genes$cluster)))
  )
  
  # order windows numerically
  window_df <- window_df[order(window_df$window_num), ]
  windows <- window_df$cluster
  
  # keep only DEG rows where gene is in OpenTargets list
  hits <- DEG_genes[DEG_genes$gene %in% OT_genes, ]
  
  # build ordered output list
  result <- lapply(windows, function(w) {
    genes <- unique(hits$gene[hits$cluster == w])
    if (length(genes) == 0) NA else genes
  })
  
  names(result) <- windows
  
  return(result)
}

```


```{r}
OT_by_window <- find_OT_genes_per_window(
  DEG_genes = DEG_genes,
  OT_genes  = OpenTargets_MDD_Genetic_all_
)

OT_by_window

```


Calculate gene set scores for each window.
```{r}
all_gene_sets <- OT_by_window

score.mat <- matrix(
  data = NA,
  nrow = length(all_gene_sets),
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = list(names(all_gene_sets), "% of genes present")
)


for (i in seq_along(all_gene_sets)) {
  
  genes <- all_gene_sets[[i]]
  
  # case: no overlapping genes
  if (length(genes) == 1 && is.na(genes)) {
    score.mat[i, 1] <- 0
    next
  }
  
  # % of genes present in Seurat object
  score.mat[i, 1] <- mean(genes %in% rownames(se))
  
  # add module score
  se <- AddModuleScore(
    object = se,
    features = list(genes),
    ctrl = 100,
    name     = paste0(names(all_gene_sets)[i], "_")
  )
}


score.mat * 100
```
